properties.field_evidence: Official MHCLG Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42129938 explicitly records a closed, building-specific MultiPolygon named Dulwich Library, authoritative quality, Southwark organisation, and listed-building identifier 1430885. Historic England's official National Heritage List entry 1430885 independently identifies Dulwich Library, Grade II, first listed 17 March 2016, a purpose-built Passmore Edwards public library of 1896-1897 at 368 Lordship Lane. Structural classification 'Library' is supported; current operating status and cadastral parcel intersection are not claimed. The source footprint is an official listed-building outline rather than a canonical parcel.
